method: Optimized whole-HUD fixture. Sequential isolated runs with ambient on, Reduce Motion off. CPU is percent of one core for the app process; source submission cadence is not display FPS. Instruments and WindowServer/GPU utilization measurements unavailable. These are single runs, not statistical guarantees.
